why: Canon revision 3 (writing team, 2026-11-08): Cordula black on black on grey with calf karambits and no tank, Barnaby kraken-scale and dark at rest (crimson/white only while dancing), never carried, black misting harness, blackened brass collar. New hero, the three Cordula cards, a dark-at-rest Barnaby base card, and the Shelly base card on the updated model sheet.

renders.name: banner-pier59-danceoff
renders.subject: {CORDULA} mid dance-off on the folded, tilted concrete floor of Pier 59, twirling her black paddle like a color-guard staff, dwarfed beside her by {BARNABY_DANCE}, his eight huge arms sweeping the dance floor in time with hers, a tiny round green lumpsucker fish and a geoduck siphon watching from a tide pool at the edge, shattered aquarium glass and floodwater behind them, Seattle waterfront skyline in rain beyond, the pair dancing as equals at impossible octopus scale

place.where: hero slot at the top (the Gertie wreck plate stands in until this lands)
place.alt: Cordula in black on black on grey dancing with her paddle beside kraken-scale Barnaby flashing crimson and white, on the folded Pier 59 floor

renders.name: card-cast-cordula
renders.subject: {CORDULA}, standing full body in shallow floodwater on dark stone, grinning, her black touring paddle held upright beside her like a color-guard staff, rain beading on matte black neoprene, calm and ready, the night operator of the party

place.where: party table and Cordula section speaker card
place.alt: Cordula Vance grinning in a matte black drysuit, charcoal vest and grey webbing, karambits sheathed on her calves, holding a black kayak paddle upright

renders.name: card-cast-cordula-drill
renders.subject: {CORDULA} dancing her drill-cadence style mid-step, black paddle spinning in a color-guard twirl, every move exactly on the beat, water spraying from her boots in a dark arena, fierce grin, endurance dancer who never misses a count

place.where: Cordula section, beside the drill image
place.alt: Cordula dancing her drill-cadence style in black on black on grey, paddle twirling, water spraying from her boots

renders.name: card-cast-cordula-benched
renders.subject: {CORDULA} benched and spent after a dance-off, sitting on a wet stone bench wrapped in a dark grey blanket over her drysuit, black paddle resting across her knees, sheathed karambits on her calves, tired crooked grin, steam rising off a tin cup beside her

place.where: Cordula section, beside the benched image
place.alt: Cordula benched after a dance-off, wrapped in a dark blanket, paddle across her knees, tired grin

renders.name: card-cast-barnaby
renders.subject: {BARNABY} at rest on wet dark dungeon stone beside a tide channel, wearing a black misting hydration harness on his mantle with a fine spray keeping his skin wet, one great eye on the viewer, arms spread wide enough to fill the frame, immense, calm and dry-witted, moving entirely under his own power

place.where: party table and Barnaby speaker card
place.alt: Barnaby, a kraken-scale Giant Pacific Octopus, dark charcoal and slate at rest, black misting harness on his mantle, blackened brass collar glowing faint violet

renders.name: card-cast-shelly
renders.subject: Shelly the geoduck at home in his tide flat: {GEODUCK}, the shell half buried in wet sand among eelgrass, the long siphon neck curving up and puffing a soft cloud of sea mist, a steel carabiner clipped to a stout ring on the shell, placid and immovable

place.where: party table and Shelly section base card
place.alt: Shelly the geoduck, a small pale shell half buried in sand among eelgrass, his long siphon puffing sea mist, a carabiner clipped to his shell
